A Bit More About Me

How a decade of road trips turned into a full-time habit.

I picked up a camera on a cross-country road trip a decade ago and never really put it down. What started as trip photos turned into paid editorial work, then a slow migration into writing about the places themselves, not just photographing them.

These days about half my time is client work — editorial and travel commissions — and half is this site: long-form essays and images from wherever I've been most recently.
